additionalInformation: Courses that depend on CS2109S would expect that students have been exposed to the following: An evaluation of the machine learning part, so that students have some basic knowledge of what to look out for when deploying machine learning An introduction to transformers for the deep learning part, as it has become the dominant architecture in practice”
description: This course introduces basic concepts in artificial intelligence and machine learning and examines the associated techniques. Topics covered include search algorithms, optimisation tools, introductions to supervised and unsupervised learning, including neural networks and model validation. Applications and ethical considerations will be discussed.
